domain: V=3, ISOLATE=1; signed11 membrane plus statically signed8 current; exact signed12 sum
limits: No RTL simulator run by this reviewer
No sequential reset/backpressure or reachability proof
No routing or SDF timing check
No measured switching or energy result

one_hot_selection.certificate: Priority selected_mask is one-hot-or-zero. Each masked OR term vanishes unless selected; a selected lane equals the original mux, and the all-zero mask forces both arithmetic operands to zero.
one_hot_selection.scope: All work masks, each lane/nibble independently, all 64 current-sign vectors; bitwise separability checked against the exact RTL source. Not all 16**6 membrane vectors enumerated.

scalar_algebra.certificate: Bad lanes have c != sign(I8), hence hI+c is exactly +1 or -1; hU plus adjustment is the exact quotient.

source_review.fixture_preservation_attributes: Original attributes retained identically; none added for isolation
precise_changes: One-hot masked OR of HU and current sign, with zero adjustment when selected_mask is zero
source_review.scheduler_register_reset_and_dsp_logic: Byte-equivalent after the two specified substitutions (newline-normalized)

write_implication.implication: Every high-part write implies selected_any. Last busy corrections are active. Blocked and stale-invalid exceptions may keep arithmetic active but write no output.
write_implication.scope: Combinational implication over a superset of reachable states; no sequential/formal reachability proof.
